scope: Approved first decision-engine pass: source inventory, behavioral baseline and portable PostgreSQL transaction/enqueue preparation; not a MySQL implementation/cutover
implemented: Source-hashed drift inventory covering 85 production/migration files, including all 44 decision metadata up/down files, ports, tenant-reader factory and PostgreSQL adapters. Qualified references, SQL feature markers and Scan-call counts are lexical observations, not an inferred target schema or complete dynamic-query parser.

Grouped ownership/access inventory documenting authoring, decisions/evidence, historical reads, ordered workflow snapshots, execution/queue work, screening/scoring configuration, source reconciliation, platform effects, search/cursors and shared investigator contracts.

Typed owner JobRequest mutation contract for scheduled/async evaluation, callbacks, workflow, screening, scoring and outbox. No pgx/River imports remain in production service/port code; an AST boundary test enforces this.

PostgreSQL adapter owns producer wiring and validates nonzero tenant/resource IDs and owner-row binding in the same transaction as queue insertion. The lookup is a fixed-table primary-key operation, not caller-supplied SQL. It adds a per-enqueue lookup; no performance optimization is claimed.

Removed required no-op producer types and non-atomic retry fallbacks. Every concrete required producer rejects missing client/transaction. Router/app initialization propagates River client errors. Existing optional-outbox enable/disable semantics remain intact.

Execution terminal state, required callback jobs and enabled lifecycle outbox events now commit together. Failed transition recovery matches tenant, resource, running state and attempt; committed terminal or newer attempts are not reset. Cleanup has an independent five-second budget and retains the original error.

Transaction manager rejects missing infrastructure, rolls back cancellation/panic/callback failures with independent cleanup and reports rollback errors instead of ignoring them. Existing transaction timing collection is preserved.
Added service baseline assertions for approve/review/block-and-review/decline score boundaries, no-hit evidence, persisted decision identity/request and response/persistence agreement.
Added private disposable PostgreSQL test fixture and required-integration configuration guard; each service integration test creates/drops only a generated local decision_test_* database.
Fixed pre-existing test-only concurrent Gin global-mode writes by initializing mode once per package without disabling parallel tests.

API, worker and migrator explicitly select the public River schema. API/worker startup and API readiness check pinned lineage, required objects and runtime-role privileges. Readiness is fail-closed for missing infrastructure, bounded and read-only; it never repairs the shared queue or replaces transactional INSERT error handling.

verification.suite: Decision-engine full Go vet/race suite with real PostgreSQL service fixtures
verification.command: docker compose -p decision-port-test -f backend/decision-engine-service/compose.test.yaml -f /tmp/decision-port-test-go.yml run --rm --pull never test
verification.executed_inside_fixture: go mod download && go vet ./... && go test -mod=readonly -race -count=1 -timeout=240s ./...
verification.environment: Private PostgreSQL 16 tmpfs fixture; Go 1.25.0 cached-image override; DECISION_ENGINE_REQUIRE_INTEGRATION=1 and local decision_test_admin URL; no published DB ports or application network
verification.limitations: Committed Go fixture image remains 1.25.8. Separate existing store tests requiring DECISION_TEST_DATABASE_URL were intentionally not configured; passing the service fixture does not certify those specialized suites or full-system migration ordering. No MySQL or Aurora integration was run for decision repositories because those repositories are not implemented.

verification.suite: New real-PostgreSQL boundary and recovery tests
tests: TestIntegrationAllDecisionJobsAtomicAndTenantBound (all seven kinds; cross-tenant rejection, callback-error rollback, exact resource and scheduled instant/state)
TestIntegrationRequiredQueueFailureRollsBackOwner (real River INSERT constraint failure for each kind rolls back preceding owner mutation; missing producer fails)

TestIntegrationAsyncCompletionCallbackRollbackAndRecovery (actual callback INSERT failure rolls back completion; same-attempt recovery, cross-tenant and stale-attempt refusal, successful callback commit, terminal preservation)
TestIntegrationDecisionQueueCancellationAndPanicRollback (owner mutation and queue insert both roll back)
Existing TestIntegrationDecisionOutboxPublicationAtomicity, async validation and rule evidence persistence tests remain active and passed
TestDecisionQueueReadinessRequiresPinnedSchema (missing schema, pinned migrations, explicit public schema despite altered search_path, future lineage rejection, missing uniqueness index)
TestDecisionQueueReadinessSeparatesProducerAndWorkerAccess (least-privilege producer, denied worker access, granted worker access, denied sequence usage)
TestRouterQueueStartupAndReadiness and TestRouterWithoutDatabaseIsNotReady (startup refusal, readiness after migrations, post-start table removal, independent liveness)

verification.suite: Host full decision-engine unit/regression race suite
verification.command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.0 GOCACHE=/tmp/fraud-foundation-go-cache go vet ./...; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.0 GOCACHE=/tmp/fraud-foundation-go-cache go test -race -count=1 ./...

corrected_verification_failures: First host full run could not bind local httptest ports under sandbox restrictions; reran with approved escalation.
Race detector exposed existing parallel Gin.SetMode writes; moved mode initialization to TestMain.

Portable-boundary extraction required updating fakes and constructor callers; missing required queue dependencies now fail explicitly rather than using no-ops. Idempotent-replay tests now inspect the actual port recorder, not an unused transport mock.
Initial synthetic seed reused a parameter across UUID and text contexts, producing SQLSTATE 42P08. Corrected fixture parameter contexts and reran the entire real-DB suite.
An early Docker run overlapped source/inventory edits and correctly detected inventory drift. Regenerated after source review and the final stable-source run passed.
remaining_implementation_and_acceptance: DE-01.1 full source-to-target column/type/collation/constraint/index/grant manifest and semantic query mapping; source inventory alone is not that manifest.
Decision MySQL repositories/migrations and cross-owner dependency installation, restricted authorization/grants and durable MySQL queue adapters.
Registry-authorized MySQL historical reads, SQL aggregates and direct_db/ingestion_http parity; current reader-mode fallback is unchanged and must be reviewed before target activation.
MySQL scenario/workflow authoring, ordered bounded snapshots, pagination/collation semantics and decision-owned screening source reconciliation.

Explicit retry/redrive identity and retained-argument River deduplication review; this pass preserves existing payloads and transport uniqueness, and does not certify retry/rescue delivery completeness.
Full stale-worker effect fencing, exactly-once local effect receipts, legacy work translation/import, persisted schedule watermarks and external receiver idempotency.
Complete queue schema-drift auditing and target MySQL queue readiness beyond the implemented PostgreSQL pinned-version/object/access checks.
Full cross-engine AST/numeric/null/JSON/collation evidence corpus, concurrent authoring/snapshot tests, all-owner migration compatibility and representative query plans/load acceptance.
Aurora testing remains excluded by the user.
